scientific.integrity: The source practical M-SVAG recurrence is solved exactly for a deterministic period-two gradient. Bias-corrected moving moments and the finite-sample variance correction yield closed asymptotic variance and gain formulas.
limitations: One-coordinate deterministic externally prescribed gradient sequence.
Frequency-response diagnostic rather than a fixed-objective convergence theorem.
Persistent alternation violates the source local-stationarity model and is used intentionally as a boundary test.
No claim about typical stochastic-gradient spectra.

title: M-SVAG has an exact coherent-alternation attenuation law
